name: Power Hour
description: Full-body barbell strength training. Progressive overload principles with compound lifts. All levels welcome — weights scale to your ability.

name: Vinyasa Flow
description: Dynamic flowing yoga connecting breath to movement. Build flexibility, balance, and mindfulness in a heated room.

name: Burn Circuit
description: 30-second all-out intervals with active recovery. Kettlebells, battle ropes, box jumps, and bodyweight movements. Bring a towel.

name: Core Sculpt
description: Mat-based Pilates focused on deep core activation, spinal mobility, and postural alignment. Low impact, high results.

name: MetCon Mayhem
description: Metabolic conditioning WODs combining gymnastics, weightlifting, and cardio. Scaled options for every fitness level.

name: Ride or Die
description: Interval-based indoor cycling with hill climbs, sprints, and endurance blocks. Curated playlists that match the energy.

name: Yin & Restore
description: Slow, deep stretching with holds of 3-5 minutes. Targets connective tissue and nervous system recovery. Perfect for rest days.

name: Box Fit
description: Non-contact boxing fitness combining heavy bag work, footwork drills, and conditioning circuits. Stress relief guaranteed.

name: Barre Burn
description: Ballet-inspired movements using the barre, light weights, and bodyweight to sculpt long, lean muscle. Expect to shake.

name: Olympic Lift Lab
description: Technique-focused class for clean & jerk and snatch progressions. Small group format with individual coaching attention.
